comparison.objective: Insert six labeled drawers into matching slots in order and push each flush; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated large-part alignment, ordered insertion, and flush seating versus small-tool engagement, collar tuning, counterholding, and torque-bounded locking.
comparison.success_condition: All six drawers must occupy matching slots in sequence with flush fronts; candidate requires repeated safe impact stops and lock retention. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Ordered drawer insertion tests repeated fit and sequencing, not adjustment based on measured dynamic response.
